Before now, the Deluxe was the same as the standard but with the boost on the stomp instead of a switch. The v2 comes with a new EQ, more control and much more versatility. The first thing you’ll notice is the 3 band EQ. With this, you will be able to sculpt your tone like never before. We’ve also added bright and bass boosts, so you can get that fresh tone or the thump of a 4x12”. Then, we added the “Valve Screamer” based pre gain boost (that you can use when the pedal is bypassed) – we all know how good this style of circuit pushes gain stages… Then, the secret weapon. On the side is the SAG switch. This can allow you to remove that saggy crunch and tighten the response up dramatically, so – this v2 offers not only an updated take on a Wampler classic, but also a plethora of new features that will be irresistible to tone chasers everywhere! IndyGuitarist Wampler Pedals browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Wampler Pedals Pinnacle Deluxe v2 Published on November 3, 2016 Wampler Pedals boost / preamp distortion pedal Information The Wampler Pinnacle Deluxe v2 is a high-gain distortion pedal engineered to deliver the celebrated EVH-inspired "Brown Sound" while offering significantly expanded tonal control and flexibility over earlier versions. Originally introduced as the Pinnacle, the circuit was praised by Zeke Clark, longtime guitar technician for Eddie Van Halen, for authentically capturing the aggressive mids, harmonic saturation, and dynamic response associated with classic hot-rodded amplifier tones. Over time, the design evolved from a straightforward high-gain distortion with interactive tone shaping into a more versatile platform capable of covering everything from mild overdrive to modern high-gain rock and metal. The original Pinnacle featured four primary controls: Gain, Volume, and two interactive tone controls that functioned similarly to a parametric-style EQ, allowing users to sweep from scooped midrange textures to thick, warm mids. A Bright switch provided additional high-frequency emphasis for darker amplifiers, while a Gain Boost toggle altered the internal gain structure to shift the pedal from overdrive into more aggressive distortion territory. The Standard and Deluxe versions shared the same core tone, with the Deluxe model replacing the Gain Boost toggle with a dedicated footswitch for on-the-fly activation and adding an internal volume trim for extended output headroom. The Deluxe enclosure was correspondingly larger to accommodate the added switching. The Pinnacle Deluxe v2 builds upon this foundation with a comprehensive redesign aimed at increased tonal sculpting and performance control. The original tone stack was replaced with an active 3-band EQ featuring dedicated Bass, Mids, and Treble controls. This expanded EQ section enables precise tone-shaping, from tight low-end punch and scooped mids to forward, cutting lead tones.
